threading.finding: Environment.ProcessorCount sets Core.MultiProcessor and prints recognized logical processor count. This does not promise parallel NPC thinking.
Core world loop calls Timer.Slice and MessagePump.Slice as serial phases.
Dedicated TimerThread schedules/enqueues due timers; Timer.Slice invokes OnTick callbacks on the world loop.
AITimer.OnTick calls ProcessTurnBasedPulse; OnThink/Think and ordinary movement/combat decisions use this callback path, not one worker per recognized core.
PathFollower constructs MovementPath synchronously. FastAStar uses shared static mutable buffers; do not dispatch world pathfinding or entity mutation into arbitrary background tasks.
Asynchronous socket receive callbacks enqueue work; MessagePump.Slice dispatches packet handlers on the world loop.

Socket send completion is asynchronous. WorldSendTimer drains the world-send queue through ordinary timer callbacks; m_WorldSendDrainThread stores a thread ID, not a dedicated worker. ThreadPool writes diagnostics.

Six recognized logical processors select DualSaveStrategy: items on a separate thread while mobiles/guilds serialize on the caller, then Join. Optional AsyncWriter disk workers depend on World.SaveType and background-write permission. This does not parallelize live AI.
Parallel.ForEach for startup serializer validation is conditional on Framework_4_0. The verified Release|x86 build defines TRACE and does not enable that conditional.

Verified tracked PE is x86 and not LargeAddressAware. Server GC is enabled. Twenty GB of machine RAM is not twenty GB of address space available to this process; actual process headroom still needs measurement.

implementation.shared_director_scheduler: One fair round-robin timer across registered encounter implementations, shared terrain/route/new-actor/scenery tokens. Counts10 active historical controllers; stress envelope16 includes six additional directors, not a lifetime or configured-controller cap.
implementation.overlap: One territory-cell claim per facet across all current attempts, including suppression tombstones until that queen ends. No doubled territory density or ownership overwrite; no player housing reservation.
implementation.persistence: Finite-map per-cell records and compact surviving actors. Queen actual entity is retained. Quiet actors may compact only without relevant players/NPCs, active combat/effects/modifiers, or recent threats. Logical GUID, wounds, resources, inventory and slot survive; compact territory does not heal or fight virtually.
implementation.protection: Sector.MobileEntering admits survivors before world snapshots, even in already active sectors. Combined player/pet/NPC envelopes and aggression promote owed survivors above soft admission targets. Existing AI is not reduced for budgets; new background work waits.
implementation.staging: Only arachnid content implemented. Production activation false; selected clones and active clients still required. Five ranks provisional until reachable/native behavior evidence.
